h1.en: Just Lost Your Job in South Carolina? Here Are Your 2026 Health Insurance Options
h1.es: Acaba de Perder Su Trabajo en Carolina del Sur? Opciones de Seguro Medico 2026

subhero.en: You have 60 days from your last day of employer coverage to enroll in a new plan. South Carolina did not expand Medicaid, so the ACA Marketplace is the primary option for most SC residents who lose job-based coverage.
subhero.es: Tiene 60 dias desde su ultimo dia de cobertura del empleador para inscribirse. Carolina del Sur no expandio Medicaid, por lo que el Mercado ACA es la opcion principal para la mayoria de residentes de SC.

heading.en: You have 60 days from your South Carolina coverage loss date
heading.es: Tiene 60 dias desde la fecha de perdida de cobertura en Carolina del Sur

body.en: Your 60-day loss-of-coverage Special Enrollment Period (SEP) starts the day after your employer coverage ends. For example, if your last day of coverage is July 1, 2026, your SEP window runs July 2 through August 30, 2026. Miss that window and you typically wait until the next ACA Open Enrollment starting November 1, 2026, for coverage that begins January 1, 2027. South Carolina Medicaid (not expanded) is year-round only for very narrow qualifying categories such as pregnant women, children under 19, and certain disabled adults.
body.es: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias comienza el dia despues de que termina su cobertura del empleador. Por ejemplo, si su ultimo dia de cobertura es el 1 de julio de 2026, su ventana SEP corre del 2 de julio al 30 de agosto de 2026. Si pierde esa ventana, tipicamente espera hasta la proxima Inscripcion Abierta del ACA que comienza el 1 de noviembre de 2026 para cobertura del 1 de enero de 2027.

label.en: SC Medicaid (pregnant women, children, disabled only)
label.es: Medicaid de SC (mujeres embarazadas, ninos, discapacitados unicamente)

quickAnswer.en: Losing job-based coverage in South Carolina triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period. South Carolina is one of 10 states that did not expand Medicaid under the ACA, so most adults below 65 who lose their jobs must use the ACA Marketplace rather than Medicaid. Your three main paths are: (1) ACA Marketplace plan with premium tax credits, often $10 to $300/month after subsidies, (2) COBRA continuation of your old plan at 102% of the full premium, typically $500 to $2,000/month, or (3) your spouse's employer plan if your spouse's employer allows a 30-day qualifying event enrollment. Children under 19 may qualify for SC CHIP (the South Carolina Healthy Connections Kids program) at incomes up to 208% FPL regardless of your employment status.
quickAnswer.es: Perder la cobertura del empleo en Carolina del Sur activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias. Carolina del Sur es uno de 10 estados que no expandio Medicaid bajo la ACA, por lo que la mayoria de adultos menores de 65 que pierden su trabajo deben usar el Mercado ACA. Sus tres opciones principales son: (1) plan del Mercado ACA con creditos fiscales de prima, frecuentemente $10 a $300 al mes despues de subsidios, (2) continuacion COBRA de su plan anterior al 102% de la prima completa, tipicamente $500 a $2,000 al mes, o (3) el plan del empleador de su conyuge si permite inscripcion por evento calificador en 30 dias.

introParagraphs.en: Losing a job in South Carolina means losing employer-sponsored health coverage, often on the same day or within days. South Carolina law follows federal COBRA rules for employers with 20 or more employees, giving you the right to continue your old plan for up to 18 months at 102% of the full premium. That sounds reassuring until you see the bill: average family COBRA premiums in 2026 run $1,400 to $2,800 per month for a South Carolina plan. For most people who just lost income, COBRA is unaffordable. The ACA Marketplace is the first option to examine. South Carolina uses the federal Marketplace at healthcare.gov, where premium tax credits reduce monthly costs dramatically for most laid-off workers. A person earning $30,000 in projected annual income for 2026 will typically qualify for a Marketplace plan costing under $100 per month after subsidies. The critical fact to understand about South Carolina: the state chose not to expand Medicaid under the ACA, meaning most adults between 18 and 64 do not qualify for standard Medicaid simply because they lost a job. The coverage gap is real. Adults who project income below 100% of the Federal Poverty Level for 2026 (below $15,960 for a single person) fall into a gap where they earn too little for ACA subsidies but do not qualify for South Carolina Healthy Connections Medicaid as a working-age adult without dependents.
introParagraphs.es: Perder un trabajo en Carolina del Sur significa perder la cobertura de salud patrocinada por el empleador, frecuentemente el mismo dia o dentro de pocos dias. Las leyes de Carolina del Sur siguen las reglas federales de COBRA para empleadores con 20 o mas empleados, dandole el derecho de continuar su plan anterior por hasta 18 meses al 102% de la prima completa. Eso suena tranquilizador hasta que ve la factura: las primas promedio de COBRA familiar en 2026 rondan $1,400 a $2,800 al mes para un plan de Carolina del Sur. Para la mayoria de personas que acaban de perder sus ingresos, COBRA no es asequible. El Mercado ACA es la primera opcion a examinar. Carolina del Sur usa el Mercado federal en healthcare.gov, donde los creditos fiscales de prima reducen los costos mensuales dramaticamente para la mayoria de trabajadores despedidos. Una persona que gana $30,000 en ingresos anuales proyectados para 2026 tipicamente calificara para un plan del Mercado que cuesta menos de $100 al mes despues de subsidios.

introParagraphs.en: South Carolina's Healthy Connections Medicaid program covers children under 19 through the Healthy Connections Kids (SC CHIP) program at incomes up to 208% FPL, which in 2026 means up to about $33,200 for a family of 4. Pregnant women qualify for SC Healthy Connections Medicaid at incomes up to 194% FPL through 60 days postpartum. Certain disabled adults and SSI recipients qualify for Medicaid year-round regardless of income. But for a typical working-age adult without a disability who just lost a job, South Carolina Medicaid is simply not an option. That gap makes it more important to act within the 60-day window and compare your ACA Marketplace options carefully. The 2026 ACA Open Enrollment Period already ended January 15, 2026, for coverage starting February 1. Your job loss SEP is the primary mechanism available to you now. Act before your 60-day clock expires. Children in your household who lost coverage should be screened for SC CHIP immediately, as CHIP enrollment is year-round in South Carolina with no deadline.
introParagraphs.es: El programa Medicaid Healthy Connections de Carolina del Sur cubre a ninos menores de 19 anos a traves del programa Healthy Connections Kids (SC CHIP) con ingresos de hasta el 208% FPL, que en 2026 significa hasta aproximadamente $33,200 para una familia de 4. Las mujeres embarazadas califican para Medicaid Healthy Connections de SC con ingresos de hasta el 194% FPL hasta 60 dias posparto. Ciertos adultos discapacitados y receptores de SSI califican para Medicaid todo el ano. Pero para un adulto tipico en edad laboral sin discapacidad que acaba de perder su trabajo, Medicaid de Carolina del Sur simplemente no es una opcion. Esa brecha hace mas importante actuar dentro de la ventana de 60 dias y comparar sus opciones del Mercado ACA cuidadosamente.

name.en: Confirm your SEP start date and mark your 60-day deadline
name.es: Confirme su fecha de inicio del SEP y marque su fecha limite de 60 dias

text.en: Your Marketplace SEP begins the day after your employer coverage ends, not the day you are laid off. If you have pay-period coverage that extends past your last day of work, your 60-day clock starts the day after coverage actually ends. Check your termination letter, COBRA notice, or call HR to confirm the exact last day of coverage before calculating your deadline.
text.es: Su SEP del Mercado comienza el dia despues de que termina la cobertura de su empleador, no el dia del despido. Si tiene cobertura que se extiende mas alla de su ultimo dia de trabajo, su reloj de 60 dias comienza el dia despues de que la cobertura termine realmente. Verifique su carta de terminacion, aviso COBRA o llame a RRHH para confirmar el ultimo dia exacto de cobertura.

name.en: Calculate your projected 2026 household income for subsidy eligibility
name.es: Calcule su ingreso familiar proyectado para 2026 para la elegibilidad de subsidios

text.en: ACA Marketplace subsidies are based on your projected Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for the full calendar year 2026. Use only what you expect to earn going forward, not your old salary. Include unemployment compensation if you will collect it. In South Carolina, unemployment benefits count as income for ACA subsidy calculations. The 2026 subsidy range runs from 100% FPL ($15,960 for a single person) up to 400% FPL ($63,840 for a single person). If your projected 2026 income falls below 100% FPL, you fall into the coverage gap because South Carolina did not expand Medicaid. Seek free enrollment help through the SC Navigator Network or encorepact.org.
text.es: Los subsidios del Mercado ACA se basan en su Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) proyectado para todo el ano calendario 2026. Use solo lo que espera ganar en adelante, no su salario anterior. Incluya la compensacion por desempleo si la cobrara. En Carolina del Sur, los beneficios de desempleo cuentan como ingreso para los calculos de subsidios del ACA. El rango de subsidios de 2026 va del 100% FPL ($15,960 para una persona) hasta el 400% FPL ($63,840 para una persona).

name.en: Check children in your household for SC CHIP (Healthy Connections Kids)
name.es: Verifique si los ninos de su hogar califican para SC CHIP (Healthy Connections Kids)

text.en: South Carolina's CHIP program, called Healthy Connections Kids, covers uninsured children under age 19 at household incomes up to 208% FPL in 2026 (about $33,200 for a family of 4). CHIP enrollment is year-round with no deadline. Apply through the SC Department of Health and Human Services at scdhhs.gov or call 1-888-549-0820. Children who had employer coverage through you may qualify for CHIP immediately after losing coverage.
text.es: El programa CHIP de Carolina del Sur, llamado Healthy Connections Kids, cubre a ninos no asegurados menores de 19 anos con ingresos familiares de hasta el 208% FPL en 2026 (aproximadamente $33,200 para una familia de 4). La inscripcion en CHIP es todo el ano sin fecha limite. Solicite a traves del Departamento de Salud y Servicios Humanos de SC en scdhhs.gov o llame al 1-888-549-0820.

name.en: Compare ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov using your 60-day SEP
name.es: Compare planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov usando su SEP de 60 dias

text.en: Log in to healthcare.gov and report your qualifying life event (job loss) to trigger the Special Enrollment Period. South Carolina has multiple carriers on the federal Marketplace for 2026, including BlueCross BlueShield of South Carolina, Ambetter from Select Health of South Carolina, and Molina Healthcare. Compare Silver plans first because cost-sharing reductions (CSRs) are only available on Silver plans and can dramatically reduce your deductible and out-of-pocket maximum if your income is below 250% FPL. Use your actual ZIP code for accurate plan availability and premium quotes.
text.es: Inicie sesion en healthcare.gov y reporte su evento calificador de vida (perdida de empleo) para activar el Periodo de Inscripcion Especial. Carolina del Sur tiene multiples aseguradoras en el Mercado federal para 2026, incluyendo BlueCross BlueShield de Carolina del Sur, Ambetter de Select Health of South Carolina y Molina Healthcare. Compare primero los planes Silver porque las reducciones de costos compartidos (CSR) solo estan disponibles en planes Silver.

name.en: Evaluate COBRA as a short-term bridge if your situation warrants it
name.es: Evalúe COBRA como puente a corto plazo si su situacion lo justifica

text.en: COBRA continuation under South Carolina plans is governed by federal rules for employers with 20 or more employees. You pay 102% of the full premium (employer plus employee share plus 2% administration fee). For most South Carolina workers, that means $500 to $900 per month for individual coverage and $1,400 to $2,800 per month for family coverage in 2026. COBRA makes sense only if you have active treatment with a provider not in any Marketplace network, or if you have already met a large deductible for the calendar year that you want to protect through December 31, 2026. You have 60 days to elect COBRA and can also enroll in Marketplace coverage simultaneously during your SEP.
text.es: La continuacion COBRA bajo los planes de Carolina del Sur se rige por las reglas federales para empleadores con 20 o mas empleados. Paga el 102% de la prima completa. Para la mayoria de trabajadores de Carolina del Sur, eso significa $500 a $900 al mes para cobertura individual y $1,400 a $2,800 al mes para cobertura familiar en 2026. COBRA tiene sentido solo si tiene tratamiento activo con un proveedor que no esta en ninguna red del Mercado.

name.en: Check spouse's employer plan as a 30-day option
name.es: Verifique el plan del empleador del conyuge como opcion de 30 dias

text.en: If your spouse or domestic partner has employer-based health coverage, your job loss is a qualifying life event under their plan. Most employer plans allow 30 days from the qualifying event to add you. Call your spouse's HR department immediately, as the 30-day window is shorter than the 60-day Marketplace SEP and may be cheaper than COBRA or Marketplace premiums depending on the employer contribution.
text.es: Si su conyuge o pareja domestica tiene cobertura de salud del empleador, su perdida de empleo es un evento calificador de vida bajo su plan. La mayoria de planes del empleador permiten 30 dias desde el evento calificador para agregarle. Llame al departamento de RRHH de su conyuge de inmediato, ya que la ventana de 30 dias es mas corta que el SEP del Mercado de 60 dias.

name.en: Enroll and submit your proof of qualifying event documentation
name.es: Inscribase y envie su documentacion de prueba del evento calificador

text.en: Submit a termination letter, COBRA election notice, or letter from your former employer confirming your coverage end date when healthcare.gov requests verification. Most SEP enrollments go through without upfront documentation, but the Marketplace may request verification within 30 days of enrollment. Failure to submit documentation can result in your plan being cancelled retroactively. Keep your termination letter, pay stubs showing final payroll date, and any written notice of benefit end date in a folder for 90 days.
text.es: Envie una carta de terminacion, aviso de eleccion COBRA o carta de su ex empleador que confirme su fecha de fin de cobertura cuando healthcare.gov lo solicite. La mayoria de inscripciones SEP se procesan sin documentacion inicial, pero el Mercado puede solicitar verificacion dentro de los 30 dias de la inscripcion. Mantenga su carta de terminacion y estados de pago en una carpeta durante 90 dias.

footnote.en: South Carolina did not expand Medicaid under the ACA. Adults 19 to 64 without a disability who lose job-based coverage cannot qualify for standard SC Medicaid regardless of income. ACA subsidy amounts depend on your projected 2026 household income. The 2026 ACA subsidy cliff is at 400% FPL ($63,840 for a single person) after enhanced premium tax credits expired January 1, 2026.
footnote.es: Carolina del Sur no expandio Medicaid bajo la ACA. Adultos de 19 a 64 anos sin discapacidad que pierden cobertura laboral no pueden calificar para Medicaid de SC independientemente de sus ingresos. Los montos de subsidios del ACA dependen de su ingreso familiar proyectado para 2026. El precipicio de subsidios del ACA 2026 esta en el 400% FPL ($63,840 para una sola persona) despues de que los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026.

intro.en: South Carolina residents who just lost job-based coverage commonly make these costly mistakes:
intro.es: Los residentes de Carolina del Sur que acaban de perder la cobertura del trabajo frecuentemente cometen estos errores costosos:

items.en: Assuming South Carolina Medicaid covers job loss. SC is a non-expansion state. Most working-age adults without a disability or dependent child simply do not qualify for SC Healthy Connections Medicaid, regardless of income. Verify eligibility before counting on Medicaid as a fallback.
items.es: Asumir que el Medicaid de Carolina del Sur cubre la perdida de empleo. SC es un estado sin expansion. La mayoria de adultos en edad laboral sin discapacidad o hijo dependiente simplemente no califican para Medicaid Healthy Connections de SC. Verifique la elegibilidad antes de contar con Medicaid.

items.en: Defaulting to COBRA without comparing Marketplace subsidies. COBRA costs 102% of the full premium. Most South Carolina workers who lost income qualify for ACA premium tax credits that make Marketplace Silver plans far cheaper than COBRA. Always check healthcare.gov before electing COBRA.
items.es: Optar por COBRA sin comparar los subsidios del Mercado. COBRA cuesta el 102% de la prima completa. La mayoria de trabajadores de Carolina del Sur que perdieron ingresos califican para creditos fiscales de prima del ACA que hacen los planes Silver del Mercado mucho mas baratos que COBRA.

items.en: Reporting your old salary as your projected income. ACA subsidies use your projected Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for the 2026 calendar year going forward. If you lost your $60,000 job in June, your projected annual income for the rest of 2026 may be $20,000 or less. Report what you actually expect to earn, not what you made while employed.
items.es: Reportar su salario anterior como ingreso proyectado. Los subsidios del ACA usan su Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) proyectado para el ano calendario 2026 en adelante. Si perdio su trabajo de $60,000 en junio, su ingreso anual proyectado para el resto de 2026 puede ser $20,000 o menos.

items.en: Missing the 60-day SEP window. Without an active SEP, you cannot enroll in a Marketplace plan outside of Open Enrollment. The next ACA Open Enrollment Period for South Carolina starts November 1, 2026, for 2027 coverage. A gap of several months without coverage is both financially risky and medically dangerous.
items.es: Perder la ventana del SEP de 60 dias. Sin un SEP activo, no puede inscribirse en un plan del Mercado fuera de la Inscripcion Abierta. El proximo Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta del ACA para Carolina del Sur comienza el 1 de noviembre de 2026 para cobertura de 2027.

items.en: Forgetting to enroll children in SC CHIP separately. Children in your household who lost coverage may qualify for SC Healthy Connections Kids (CHIP) at incomes up to 208% FPL, even if you yourself do not qualify for Medicaid. CHIP enrollment is year-round at scdhhs.gov. Do not leave children uninsured while you sort out your own coverage.
items.es: Olvidar inscribir a los ninos en SC CHIP por separado. Los ninos de su hogar que perdieron cobertura pueden calificar para Healthy Connections Kids de SC (CHIP) con ingresos de hasta el 208% FPL, aunque usted mismo no califique para Medicaid. La inscripcion en CHIP es todo el ano en scdhhs.gov.

items.en: Counting on unemployment as non-income. South Carolina unemployment compensation counts as Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for ACA subsidy purposes. Include your expected unemployment benefit weeks in your annual income projection to avoid a large tax reconciliation bill when you file your 2026 return.
items.es: Contar el desempleo como no-ingreso. La compensacion por desempleo de Carolina del Sur cuenta como Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) para propositos de subsidio del ACA. Incluya sus semanas esperadas de beneficio por desempleo en su proyeccion de ingresos anuales.

heading.en: COBRA vs ACA Marketplace vs Spouse's Plan: Which Is Right for South Carolina Residents?
heading.es: COBRA vs Mercado ACA vs Plan del Conyuge: Cual es Correcto para Residentes de Carolina del Sur?

paragraphs.en: South Carolina workers who lose job-based coverage face three primary pathways: COBRA continuation, the federal ACA Marketplace at healthcare.gov, or a spouse's employer plan. COBRA preserves your exact South Carolina plan with its specific provider network at 102% of the total premium. For 2026, that typically means $500 to $900 per month for individual coverage and $1,400 to $2,800 per month for a family plan. COBRA is governed by Section 9831 of HIPAA for employers with 20 or more employees, and you have 60 days from your qualifying event to elect it. The employer must provide a COBRA election notice within 14 days of the qualifying event.
paragraphs.es: Los trabajadores de Carolina del Sur que pierden la cobertura del trabajo tienen tres vias principales: continuacion COBRA, el Mercado ACA federal en healthcare.gov, o el plan del empleador de un conyuge. COBRA conserva su plan exacto de Carolina del Sur con su red de proveedores especifica al 102% de la prima total. Para 2026, eso tipicamente significa $500 a $900 al mes para cobertura individual y $1,400 a $2,800 al mes para un plan familiar.

paragraphs.en: ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov are the correct first comparison for most South Carolina residents who lost job coverage. The loss-of-coverage Marketplace SEP runs 60 days from your coverage end date. Premium tax credits for 2026 make Silver plans particularly attractive: a South Carolina household earning $25,000 annually in 2026 will typically pay under $60 per month for a Silver plan after credits, compared to $600 to $1,200 per month for COBRA on a comparable plan. Cost-sharing reductions on Silver plans (available to households below 250% FPL) further reduce the deductible and out-of-pocket maximum, making $0 deductible Silver plans accessible to many laid-off South Carolina workers. The 2026 ACA subsidy cliff returned at 400% FPL ($63,840 for a single person, $132,000 for a family of 4) after enhanced premium tax credits from the American Rescue Plan Act expired January 1, 2026. Households above 400% FPL must pay the full unsubsidized premium.
paragraphs.es: Los planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov son la primera comparacion correcta para la mayoria de residentes de Carolina del Sur que perdieron cobertura del trabajo. El SEP del Mercado por perdida de cobertura dura 60 dias desde la fecha de fin de cobertura. Los creditos fiscales de prima para 2026 hacen que los planes Silver sean particularmente atractivos: un hogar de Carolina del Sur que gana $25,000 anuales en 2026 tipicamente pagara menos de $60 al mes por un plan Silver despues de creditos.

paragraphs.en: Spouse's employer plan is the third pathway and often the cheapest. Losing job-based coverage is a qualifying life event that allows your spouse to add you during their employer plan's mid-year enrollment. Most employer plans give 30 days from the qualifying event, which is shorter than the 60-day Marketplace SEP. Call your spouse's HR department on the same day you confirm your coverage end date. The decision matrix for South Carolina in 2026: check Medicaid first for pregnant women, children, and certain disabled adults (year-round at scdhhs.gov); then check your spouse's employer plan (30-day window, often the lowest net cost); then compare Marketplace Silver plans with subsidies (60-day window, best for most adults); COBRA as a last resort for continuity of specialized care or to protect a met deductible.
paragraphs.es: El plan del empleador del conyuge es la tercera via y frecuentemente la mas economica. Perder la cobertura del trabajo es un evento calificador de vida que permite a su conyuge agregarle durante la inscripcion a mitad de ano del plan del empleador. La mayoria de planes del empleador dan 30 dias desde el evento calificador. La matriz de decision para Carolina del Sur en 2026: verificar primero Medicaid para mujeres embarazadas, ninos y ciertos adultos discapacitados; luego el plan del empleador del conyuge (ventana de 30 dias); luego comparar planes Silver del Mercado con subsidios (ventana de 60 dias); COBRA como ultimo recurso.

heading.en: South Carolina Medicaid (Healthy Connections): Who Actually Qualifies After a Job Loss
heading.es: Medicaid de Carolina del Sur (Healthy Connections): Quienes Califican Realmente Tras Perder el Trabajo

paragraphs.en: South Carolina Healthy Connections is the state's Medicaid program, administered by the SC Department of Health and Human Services (SCDHHS). South Carolina is one of 10 states that chose not to expand Medicaid under the ACA. That means the income threshold for working-age adults without qualifying medical or family circumstances is extremely low, often below 25% FPL for parents and effectively zero for single adults without disabilities. If you just lost your job as a single adult between 18 and 64 without a disability and without dependent children, you almost certainly do not qualify for SC Healthy Connections Medicaid. Apply anyway to confirm eligibility at scdhhs.gov or call 1-888-549-0820, but the Marketplace will be your primary coverage pathway.
paragraphs.es: Healthy Connections de Carolina del Sur es el programa Medicaid del estado, administrado por el Departamento de Salud y Servicios Humanos de SC (SCDHHS). Carolina del Sur es uno de 10 estados que eligio no expandir Medicaid bajo la ACA. Si acaba de perder su trabajo como adulto soltero entre 18 y 64 anos sin discapacidad y sin hijos dependientes, casi con certeza no califica para Medicaid Healthy Connections de SC. Aplique de todas formas para confirmar elegibilidad en scdhhs.gov.

paragraphs.en: South Carolina residents who do qualify for Healthy Connections Medicaid after job loss fall into these categories: pregnant women at incomes up to 194% FPL (about $31,000 for a family of 3 in 2026) through 60 days postpartum; children under 19 through the SC CHIP program (Healthy Connections Kids) at incomes up to 208% FPL; certain adults who receive SSI or meet disability criteria; and very low-income parents of Medicaid-eligible children at income thresholds that vary. SC Medicaid enrollment is year-round with no deadline for those who qualify. The SC Navigator Network provides free enrollment assistance at scnavigators.org and can help determine whether you fall into a qualifying category or should proceed to the Marketplace SEP instead.
paragraphs.es: Los residentes de Carolina del Sur que si califican para Medicaid Healthy Connections tras perder el trabajo caen en estas categorias: mujeres embarazadas con ingresos de hasta el 194% FPL hasta 60 dias posparto; ninos menores de 19 a traves del programa SC CHIP con ingresos de hasta el 208% FPL; ciertos adultos que reciben SSI o cumplen criterios de discapacidad; y padres de muy bajos ingresos de ninos elegibles para Medicaid. La Red de Navegadores de SC proporciona asistencia gratuita de inscripcion en scnavigators.org.

heading.en: Documents Needed for Your South Carolina 60-Day SEP Application
heading.es: Documentos Necesarios para Su Solicitud de SEP de 60 Dias en Carolina del Sur

paragraphs.en: Healthcare.gov (the federal Marketplace serving South Carolina) may request documentation to verify your qualifying life event. Gather these documents before you begin your Marketplace SEP application to avoid delays: a termination letter from your employer confirming your last day of employment and coverage end date; a COBRA election notice (which all employers with 20 or more employees must mail within 14 days of the qualifying event); your most recent pay stubs showing the final date of payroll deduction for health premiums; Social Security numbers for all household members applying for coverage; your South Carolina home address and ZIP code for plan availability (plans vary significantly by county); and proof of income for subsidy eligibility, which can be recent pay stubs, an unemployment award letter, or a self-certification of projected annual 2026 income if documentation is limited. Do not delay starting your application while waiting for documents. Begin at healthcare.gov immediately and submit verification within the 30-day window the Marketplace provides after initial enrollment.
paragraphs.es: Healthcare.gov (el Mercado federal que sirve a Carolina del Sur) puede solicitar documentacion para verificar su evento calificador de vida. Reuna estos documentos antes de comenzar su solicitud SEP del Mercado para evitar retrasos: una carta de terminacion de su empleador que confirme su ultimo dia de empleo y la fecha de fin de cobertura; un aviso de eleccion COBRA; sus talones de pago mas recientes; los numeros de Seguro Social de todos los miembros del hogar que solicitan cobertura; su direccion y codigo postal de Carolina del Sur; y prueba de ingresos para la elegibilidad de subsidios.

heading.en: The Coverage Gap in South Carolina: What to Do If Income Falls Below 100% FPL
heading.es: La Brecha de Cobertura en Carolina del Sur: Que Hacer si sus Ingresos Caen por Debajo del 100% FPL

paragraphs.en: South Carolina's non-expansion status creates a coverage gap for adults whose projected 2026 income falls below 100% FPL ($15,960 for a single person, $33,000 for a family of 4). These residents earn too little to qualify for ACA Marketplace premium tax credits (which require income at or above 100% FPL) but too much to qualify for SC Healthy Connections Medicaid as a working-age adult without a disability. Immediately after job loss, income projection is fluid. If you expect to be unemployed for an extended period and your projected annual income may fall below 100% FPL, you have two practical paths: report a projected income slightly above 100% FPL (which is legally acceptable if it reflects a genuine estimate, such as expected part-time income or unemployment benefits) to qualify for Marketplace subsidies; or, if you truly expect income below 100% FPL for the full year, contact a free enrollment assister through the SC Navigator Network at scnavigators.org, who can help identify any remaining SC Medicaid pathways or alternative low-cost options in your county. Free community health centers, including Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) operating under Section 330 of the Public Health Service Act, offer sliding-scale care regardless of insurance status at sites throughout South Carolina.
paragraphs.es: El estado de no expansion de Carolina del Sur crea una brecha de cobertura para adultos cuyo ingreso proyectado para 2026 cae por debajo del 100% FPL ($15,960 para una persona sola, $33,000 para una familia de 4). Estos residentes ganan demasiado poco para calificar para los creditos fiscales de prima del Mercado ACA pero demasiado para calificar para Medicaid Healthy Connections de SC como adulto en edad laboral sin discapacidad. Si espera estar desempleado por un periodo prolongado y su ingreso anual proyectado puede caer por debajo del 100% FPL, contacte a un asistente de inscripcion gratuito a traves de la Red de Navegadores de SC en scnavigators.org.

heading.en: COBRA vs ACA Marketplace vs Spouse's Plan: The South Carolina Decision Matrix
heading.es: COBRA vs Mercado ACA vs Plan del Conyuge: La Matriz de Decision para Carolina del Sur

body.en: South Carolina workers who just lost job-based coverage face a decision most people get wrong: COBRA feels safe because it keeps the same plan, but the cost is almost always prohibitive. COBRA in 2026 runs 102% of the full premium, meaning the employer contribution you never saw on your paycheck now comes out of your pocket. For most South Carolina employer plans, that means $550 to $950 per month for single coverage and $1,400 to $2,800 per month for a family. ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov are the right comparison for most laid-off SC residents. The 2026 premium tax credit formula, anchored to Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) under Section 1401 of the ACA, caps your premium at a percentage of income: a South Carolina single person earning $25,000 in projected 2026 income will pay about 4% of income, or roughly $83/month, for a benchmark Silver plan before credits, leaving a premium tax credit of $200 to $400 per month depending on the plan. South Carolina Medicaid (Healthy Connections) is not available to most adults 19-64 who lose jobs because SC did not expand under the ACA. The coverage gap for income below 100% FPL is real and requires special handling through the SC Navigator Network. Spouse's employer plan often beats both COBRA and Marketplace when your spouse's employer contributes 50% or more of the premium. The 30-day window for spouse's plan is shorter than the 60-day Marketplace SEP, so call HR immediately. Bottom line: most South Carolina adults who lose job coverage should check the Marketplace at healthcare.gov within the first two weeks of losing coverage, compare Silver plans with cost-sharing reductions if income is below 250% FPL, and elect COBRA only as a last resort or as a short bridge while Marketplace enrollment processes.
body.es: Los trabajadores de Carolina del Sur que acaban de perder la cobertura del trabajo enfrentan una decision que la mayoria comete mal: COBRA parece seguro porque mantiene el mismo plan, pero el costo es casi siempre prohibitivo. COBRA en 2026 corre al 102% de la prima completa. Para la mayoria de planes del empleador de Carolina del Sur, eso significa $550 a $950 al mes para cobertura individual y $1,400 a $2,800 al mes para una familia. Los planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov son la comparacion correcta para la mayoria de residentes de SC despedidos. El Medicaid de Carolina del Sur (Healthy Connections) no esta disponible para la mayoria de adultos de 19 a 64 anos que pierden empleos porque SC no expandio bajo la ACA. La mayoria de adultos de Carolina del Sur que pierden cobertura del trabajo deberian verificar el Mercado en healthcare.gov dentro de las primeras dos semanas de perder la cobertura.

stateRules.rule: Non-expansion state. SC Healthy Connections Medicaid does not cover most working-age adults 19-64 who lose job coverage. Coverage gap exists for adults below 100% FPL who do not meet categorical eligibility (pregnancy, disability, SSI). SC CHIP (Healthy Connections Kids) covers children under 19 at incomes up to 208% FPL. Employers with fewer than 20 employees are not subject to federal COBRA; SC has no state mini-COBRA law, meaning small-employer workers lose continuation rights.

en.question: What is the Special Enrollment Period after losing my job in South Carolina?
en.answer: Losing job-based health insurance is a qualifying life event that triggers a 60-day Marketplace Special Enrollment Period (SEP). Your SEP begins the day after your employer coverage ends, not the day you are laid off. For example, if your coverage ends July 1, 2026, your SEP window runs from July 2 through August 30, 2026. During this window, you can enroll in any ACA Marketplace plan at healthcare.gov without waiting for Open Enrollment. COBRA has a separate 60-day election window. Medicaid enrollment in South Carolina is year-round for those who qualify, but most working-age adults in SC do not qualify because SC did not expand Medicaid.

en.question: Does South Carolina have Medicaid expansion? Can I get Medicaid after losing my job?
en.answer: South Carolina has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA and remains one of 10 non-expansion states as of 2026. Most working-age adults between 19 and 64 who lose their jobs do not qualify for SC Healthy Connections Medicaid unless they are pregnant, have a qualifying disability, receive SSI, or are a very low-income parent of a Medicaid-eligible child. If your projected 2026 income falls below 100% of FPL ($15,960 for one person), you may fall into the coverage gap: ineligible for SC Medicaid and ineligible for ACA premium tax credits. Contact the SC Navigator Network at scnavigators.org for free guidance. Children in your household may qualify for SC CHIP (Healthy Connections Kids) at incomes up to 208% FPL regardless of your Medicaid status.

en.question: Is COBRA worth it after losing a job in South Carolina?
en.answer: COBRA is rarely the best financial choice for South Carolina workers who lost income. COBRA charges 102% of the full premium, which typically means $550 to $950 per month for individual coverage and $1,400 to $2,800 per month for a family plan in South Carolina in 2026. Compare that to ACA Marketplace Silver plans, which for a person earning $25,000 annually might cost under $100 per month after premium tax credits. COBRA makes sense in narrow situations: ongoing treatment with a specific provider not in any Marketplace network, or if you have already met a large 2026 deductible that you want to protect through December 31. Always compare Marketplace options at healthcare.gov before electing COBRA. You can elect COBRA as a backup and then cancel it once your Marketplace plan begins.

en.question: How do I document my job loss for the South Carolina Marketplace SEP?
en.answer: Healthcare.gov (the federal Marketplace serving South Carolina) may request verification documents after you enroll using your loss-of-coverage SEP. The most useful documents are: a termination letter from your employer confirming your last day of employment and coverage end date; a COBRA election notice, which your former employer must mail within 14 days of the qualifying event; or recent pay stubs showing the final payroll deduction date for health insurance premiums. Healthcare.gov typically allows 30 days after enrollment to submit verification. Do not wait for documents to arrive before starting your application. Begin the enrollment process at healthcare.gov immediately to protect your 60-day SEP window.

en.question: What if I miss the 60-day SEP after losing my job in South Carolina?
en.answer: Missing the 60-day loss-of-coverage SEP means you cannot enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan until the next Open Enrollment Period. For South Carolina, the next OEP starts November 1, 2026, for coverage beginning January 1, 2027. That could leave you uninsured for several months. South Carolina Medicaid enrollment is year-round, but most adults in SC do not qualify as a non-expansion state. If another qualifying life event occurs, such as a marriage, birth, or move, it can restart a new SEP. If you are a pregnant woman or child, apply for SC Healthy Connections Medicaid or CHIP at scdhhs.gov at any time.

en.question: Can my children get SC CHIP even if I do not qualify for Medicaid?
en.answer: Yes. South Carolina's CHIP program, Healthy Connections Kids, covers uninsured children under 19 at household incomes up to 208% of the Federal Poverty Level in 2026, which is approximately $33,200 for a family of 4. CHIP enrollment is year-round with no deadline and is separate from your own insurance search. Even if you do not qualify for SC Medicaid and must use the ACA Marketplace for your own coverage, your children may qualify for SC CHIP at much lower or no cost. Apply at scdhhs.gov or call the SC Department of Health and Human Services at 1-888-549-0820.

en.question: What do ACA Marketplace plans cost in South Carolina after job loss in 2026?
en.answer: ACA Marketplace plans in South Carolina are sold through the federal Marketplace at healthcare.gov. Major insurers in South Carolina for 2026 include BlueCross BlueShield of South Carolina, Ambetter from Select Health of South Carolina, and Molina Healthcare. Premium tax credits significantly reduce costs for most people who just lost income. A single person in South Carolina with a projected 2026 income of $20,000 typically pays under $50 per month for a Silver plan after credits. A family of 4 with a projected income of $50,000 typically pays $200 to $400 per month for a Silver plan after credits. For incomes below 250% FPL, cost-sharing reductions (CSRs) on Silver plans can further reduce the deductible to as low as $0. Use your actual South Carolina ZIP code at healthcare.gov for accurate quotes.

en.question: What happens to my 1095-A if I lose my job mid-year in South Carolina?
en.answer: If you enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan in South Carolina after losing your job, healthcare.gov will mail you a 1095-A form in January of the following year. The 1095-A reports the monthly premiums you paid and the advance premium tax credits (APTC) you received. You must file IRS Form 8962 with your federal tax return to reconcile your APTC with your actual 2026 income. If you underestimated your 2026 income when enrolling, you may owe some credits back. If you overestimated income, you may receive an additional credit. Include your expected unemployment compensation in your income estimate to avoid a large reconciliation bill. Keep your 1095-A with your tax documents.

es.question: Que es el Periodo de Inscripcion Especial despues de perder mi trabajo en Carolina del Sur?
es.answer: Perder el seguro de salud del trabajo es un evento calificador de vida que activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) del Mercado de 60 dias. Su SEP comienza el dia despues de que termina la cobertura de su empleador, no el dia del despido. Por ejemplo, si su cobertura termina el 1 de julio de 2026, su ventana SEP va del 2 de julio al 30 de agosto de 2026. Durante esta ventana, puede inscribirse en cualquier plan del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov sin esperar la Inscripcion Abierta. COBRA tiene una ventana de eleccion separada de 60 dias. La inscripcion en Medicaid en Carolina del Sur es todo el ano para quienes califican, pero la mayoria de adultos en edad laboral en SC no califican porque SC no expandio Medicaid.

es.question: Tiene Carolina del Sur expansion de Medicaid? Puedo obtener Medicaid despues de perder mi trabajo?
es.answer: Carolina del Sur no ha expandido Medicaid bajo la ACA y sigue siendo uno de 10 estados sin expansion a partir de 2026. La mayoria de adultos en edad laboral entre 19 y 64 anos que pierden su trabajo no califican para Medicaid Healthy Connections de SC a menos que esten embarazadas, tengan una discapacidad calificada, reciban SSI, o sean un padre de bajos ingresos de un nino elegible para Medicaid. Si su ingreso proyectado para 2026 cae por debajo del 100% del FPL ($15,960 para una persona), puede caer en la brecha de cobertura. Contacte la Red de Navegadores de SC en scnavigators.org para orientacion gratuita.

es.question: Vale la pena COBRA despues de perder un trabajo en Carolina del Sur?
es.answer: COBRA rara vez es la mejor decision financiera para los trabajadores de Carolina del Sur que perdieron ingresos. COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima completa, lo que tipicamente significa $550 a $950 al mes para cobertura individual y $1,400 a $2,800 al mes para un plan familiar en Carolina del Sur en 2026. Compare eso con los planes Silver del Mercado ACA, que para una persona que gana $25,000 anuales podrian costar menos de $100 al mes despues de creditos fiscales de prima. COBRA tiene sentido en situaciones especificas: tratamiento continuo con un proveedor especifico no en ninguna red del Mercado, o si ya alcanzo un deducible grande de 2026 que quiere proteger hasta el 31 de diciembre.

es.question: Como documento la perdida de mi trabajo para el SEP del Mercado de Carolina del Sur?
es.answer: Healthcare.gov puede solicitar documentos de verificacion despues de que se inscribe usando su SEP por perdida de cobertura. Los documentos mas utiles son: una carta de terminacion de su empleador que confirme su ultimo dia de empleo y la fecha de fin de cobertura; un aviso de eleccion COBRA; o talones de pago recientes que muestren la fecha final de deduccion de nomina para primas de seguro de salud. Healthcare.gov tipicamente permite 30 dias despues de la inscripcion para enviar la verificacion. No espere a que lleguen los documentos antes de comenzar su solicitud.

es.question: Que pasa si pierdo el SEP de 60 dias despues de perder mi trabajo en Carolina del Sur?
es.answer: Perder el SEP de 60 dias por perdida de cobertura significa que no puede inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA hasta el proximo Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta. Para Carolina del Sur, el proximo OEP comienza el 1 de noviembre de 2026 para cobertura que comienza el 1 de enero de 2027. Eso podria dejarlo sin seguro durante varios meses. Si ocurre otro evento calificador de vida, como matrimonio, nacimiento o mudanza, puede reiniciar un nuevo SEP. Si es una mujer embarazada o nino, solicite Medicaid Healthy Connections de SC o CHIP en scdhhs.gov en cualquier momento.

es.question: Pueden mis hijos obtener SC CHIP aunque yo no califique para Medicaid?
es.answer: Si. El programa CHIP de Carolina del Sur, Healthy Connections Kids, cubre a ninos no asegurados menores de 19 anos con ingresos familiares de hasta el 208% del Nivel de Pobreza Federal en 2026, que es aproximadamente $33,200 para una familia de 4. La inscripcion en CHIP es todo el ano sin fecha limite y es separada de su propia busqueda de seguro. Aunque usted no califique para Medicaid de SC y deba usar el Mercado ACA para su propia cobertura, sus hijos pueden calificar para SC CHIP. Solicite en scdhhs.gov o llame al 1-888-549-0820.

es.question: Cuanto cuestan los planes del Mercado ACA en Carolina del Sur despues de perder el trabajo en 2026?
es.answer: Los planes del Mercado ACA en Carolina del Sur se venden a traves del Mercado federal en healthcare.gov. Las principales aseguradoras en Carolina del Sur para 2026 incluyen BlueCross BlueShield de Carolina del Sur, Ambetter de Select Health of South Carolina y Molina Healthcare. Los creditos fiscales de prima reducen significativamente los costos para la mayoria de personas que acaban de perder ingresos. Una persona soltera en Carolina del Sur con un ingreso proyectado de $20,000 para 2026 tipicamente paga menos de $50 al mes por un plan Silver despues de creditos. Use su codigo postal real de Carolina del Sur en healthcare.gov para cotizaciones precisas.

es.question: Que pasa con mi 1095-A si pierdo mi trabajo a mitad del ano en Carolina del Sur?
es.answer: Si se inscribe en un plan del Mercado ACA en Carolina del Sur despues de perder su trabajo, healthcare.gov le enviara por correo un formulario 1095-A en enero del ano siguiente. El 1095-A reporta las primas mensuales que pago y los creditos fiscales de prima anticipados (APTC) que recibio. Debe presentar el Formulario 8962 del IRS con su declaracion de impuestos federal para conciliar su APTC con su ingreso real de 2026. Incluya su compensacion de desempleo esperada en su estimacion de ingresos para evitar una gran factura de conciliacion. Guarde su 1095-A con sus documentos de impuestos.
